title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Hartford HealthCare Amphitheater, Bridgeport | 2022
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Hartford HealthCare Amphitheater in Bridgeport, Connecticut, USA, on 23 September 2022.

It was the 23rd show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2022 tour of North America, which lasted for 30 dates between May and October 2022.

Starr returned to the Hartford HealthCare Amphitheater on 12 June 2025.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
